Department of Computer science and Engineering aims at providing the required technical training needed to output industry ready students. We assure maximum placement from top IT Companies. Department provides and arranges programs on career guidance, aptitude tests, mock interviews and group discussions to assist students chalk out a career path. CSE graduates are recruited by some of the world’s leading corporates like COGNIZANT, INFOSYS, TECHGINI, IBM, UNILOG, EXCELSOFT, SYNTEL, THEOREM etc. The number of companies visiting every year has been steadily increasing and the recruiters are satisfied with the large talented pool of candidates that they get to select from.
